mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative and 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases the risk of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 2.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and the CPI index signals an accelerating inflationary environment, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS 3mo change > 0 AND CPIAUCSL 3mo change > 0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), the market anticipates monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.0, the 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month change in HOUST > 0 and 20-day forward returns < 0 in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of overall economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST 3mo change > 0 AND RSAFS 3mo change > 0, the 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In strong supply growth regimes (INDPRO > 100), the market anticipates lower inflation and potential monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 100, the 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.
